quote: The driver of a vehicle may overtake and pass another vehicle upon the right only under conditions permitting such movement in safety.

obligation.description: Right-side passing is permitted only under conditions permitting movement in safety.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original passing motion, pavement and conflict conditions are evidence, not a numeric legal cutoff.
